name: प्रज्ञा नेपाली बृहत् शब्दकोश
local_name_note: This project uses the id kosha-pragya to distinguish this source from kosha-brihat. The upstream repository names the dataset Nepali Brihat Sabdakosh.

notes: The compressed JSON file is treated as the source artifact for this dictionary.
Do not edit the compressed source file directly. Add reviewable patch data if corrections are needed.
The upstream README describes the data as extracted from version 19 of the np.com.naya.sabdakosh Android app.
The upstream README says code is MIT licensed but dictionary data licensing is uncertain.

format.entry_shape: JSON objects with word and definitions fields
